subject: English
passage: Canada ratified the Paris Climate Agreement, an international accord with nearly 200 participating nations that establishes global climate goals, on October 5, 2016. Russia, ______ has yet to officially ratify the agreement; it only signed it.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?
explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. "In contrast" logically signals that the information in this sentence—that Russia has yet to officially ratify the agreement—contrasts with the previous information about Canada having already ratified the agreement.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect because "similarly" illogically signals that the information in this sentence is similar to the previous information about Canada ratifying the agreement. Instead, the sentence presents contrasting information that Russia has yet to ratify the agreement.
